headline: BOS @ KCR matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is BOS 3.73 at KCR 3.75, with a projected total of 7.48. Movement read: Both offenses moved down (BOS -0.58, KCR -0.54), so the movement points more toward run suppression than a clearer side. The projected total fell -1.11, which points to a lower-run game script than the earliest saved read. Pitching context: Ranger Suarez has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 0.8 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Bobby Witt Jr., Maikel Garcia, Michael Massey, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Caleb Durbin, Masataka Yoshida because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
